correctness.rationale: For a,b≥2, the only mixed triples are 001,100,011,110. A subgroup of S3 either joins both mixed pairs (the two singleton supports, or their complements, are in the same position-orbit) or neither; the optional constants add c to every count. For a singleton run, after relabeling, the factors are residue supports modulo m=a+b. When n<m there are n one-hot factors and the zero factor. For n=tm+r≥m there are m distinct phases, split by weight into r and m−r phases if r>0, or one class if r=0. The diagonal block permutations preserve each weight class and give any prescribed number of phase orbits in it (permute one block, fix the rest). The orbit counts add, so every intermediate target is achieved, including n=1 and r=0. The frozen replay path is `python3 verify.py` in the source record; the supplied log reports 1,662 sparse target checks and 49 long-run cases. The script and log were inspected, not executed; their finite scope is not the proof.
